name: Saint Dorei Gakuen 2
source: Prestigious all-girls school called Saint Orkis Academy was founded by the wealthy Azuma family. Although it was recently made co-educational, it still maintains its reputation as a top school. The academy is currently led by the daughter of the Azuma family's head. However, a new threat emerges in the form of the Nishiki family, a rising conglomerate that secretly trains and sells sex slaves to gain power and influence in the political and economic spheres. The Nishiki family sends a young and skilled female trainer named Kuga Kei to infiltrate the academy and take down the Azuma family. The Azuma family, unaware of his true identity, accepts him as a transfer student into the academy.
translation: 著名的女子学校圣奥尔基斯学院是由富有的东家族创办的。尽管它最近才成为男女同校，但它仍然保持着顶级学校的声誉。学院目前由东家当主的女儿领导。然而，新的威胁以锦家族的形式出现，这是一个正在崛起的企业集团，秘密训练和出售性奴隶，以在政治和经济领域获得权力和影响力。锦家族派遣一位年轻且技术精湛的女训练师久我圭潜入学院并打倒东家族。东家族不知道他的真实身份，接受他作为转学生进入学院。
